messages:
Samira (People Ops): FYI drafting a compact first-week + 30/60/90 checklist for new managers who start next Monday. Keeping it lightweight — can folks skim and flag missing items?

Jordan (Hiring Manager): 👍 will review. Can we add a short list of who-to-introduce to on day 1 (security, infra lead, buddy)?

Alex (Eng Manager): add 'meet pager responder' and 'setup oncall runbook access'. Also a tiny note about expected meeting load first week (no more than 4 x 30m).

Samira (People Ops): Good call. Draft below — comments inline welcome. Trying to keep it manager-focused (hiring/1:1s/expectations + staples like accounts + payroll).

Samira (People Ops): DRAFT: Week 0 / Day 1 agenda (for manager new hires):
- 09:00 — Welcome w/ People Ops (paperwork, benefits overview)
- 10:00 — Team intro + skip-level notes (15m intro, 15m Q&A)
- 11:00 — IT+Access (GitHub, Google, Slack, Redwood Console) 
- 12:00 — Lunch (team-sponsored) :pizza:
- 13:30 — Security & Compliance intro (access rules, SSO/KMS owner)
- 14:00 — Meet your bud (buddy intro + shadowing plan)
- 15:00 — Hiring/1:1 expectations with hiring manager (role, hiring cadence)
- 16:00 — Blocked time: set up calendar, office hours, daily scrum invite rules

Samira (People Ops): Week 1 priorities (manager):
- Run 1:1s with direct reports (first round) — use the 30/60/90 template
- Review active hiring reqs & pipeline with recruiting
- Confirm team goals for quarter (draft OK)
- Ensure CI/CD + deploy bot access
- Shadow oncall handover or schedule a separate handover if not present

Samira (People Ops): 30/60/90 (manager-level goals template):
- 30 days: meet every direct report, finish org map, quick wins (triage backlog, unblock 2 tickets), start hiring interviews
- 60 days: own at least one feature/incident postmortem, propose org/process improvements, close first hiring loop
- 90 days: deliver initial plan for next quarter, measurable team KPIs defined, onboarding checklist for new ICs updated

Priya (People Ops): tiny nit: for 30 days add 'one skip-level meeting scheduled' — helps build cross-org context early.

Jordan (Hiring Manager): Love the hiring loop milestones. Also add 'candidate feedback turnaround <= 48h' as a behavioral expectation.

Alex (Eng Manager): Ops items: add 'verify dedicated GPU quota / Redwood Dedicated access' for teams that will deploy models. Also 'request access to model catalog & deploy policy docs'.

Samira (People Ops): Got it — will add those. One more: checklist items for accounts (put as [ ] so it's actionable):
- [ ] Google workspace setup
- [ ] Slack + channel access (team, eng, infra, #oncall)
- [ ] GitHub org + repo perms
- [ ] Redwood Console access & billing view (if relevant)
- [ ] Payroll + benefits enrollment complete

Jordan (Hiring Manager): Can we add a 'who to ask' mini-list for day 1? Quick version:
- Who to ask: Priya (onboarding) for ops stuff, Alex for infra, Mia (security) for SSO/KMS, DevRel for SDK access.

Samira (People Ops): I'll make that a one-pager and attach to the offer pack. Also thinking of a short canned email managers can send to their team announcing the new hire. Sample: "Please welcome X joining as Y on Monday — I'll host a 15m intro at 10:00."

OnboardBot: Reminder: New hire checklist template has been copied to /docs/onboarding/new-manager-week1.md (auto-generated).

Priya (People Ops): Suggestion: include a 1-week pulse (quick form) for new managers after day 7: 3 Qs — access issues, clarity on role, immediate blockers. Helps us catch setup problems early.

Alex (Eng Manager): One operational ask: make sure managers get RBAC for staging environments only by default; prod access via request. Helps reduce risk while they ramp.

Samira (People Ops): Nice — I'll mark prod-access as a step requiring manager confirmation + security approval.

Jordan (Hiring Manager): This is great. My only outstanding ask — can we have a short 'expected meeting load' doc: first two weeks: max 2 interviews/day, no full-day back-to-back meetings. Helps reduce burnout for new managers.

Samira (People Ops): Will add. Thanks all. I'll fold these edits and push final one-pager tonight. If anything else, drop comments here and I'll iterate. :sparkles:
